Experience the Ultimate Maui Adventure!
The Maui app is now updated with the latest road conditions, new stories, and even more unforgettable stops.
Your journey just got even better! We’ve fixed bugs and added fresh content to make your adventure smoother and more exciting than ever!
results.description:
Explore Maui’s stunning landscapes, vibrant culture, and hidden gems with just one easy download. Our GPS-triggered audio tour covers 8 unique routes and 465+ stories, guiding you through everything Maui offers—no expiry and no need for multiple downloads.

• Road to Hana Adventures
1) Original Route – Journey the classic Road to Hana with immersive stories.

2) Return Route – Fresh tales on your drive back, offering a new perspective.

3) Loop – Experience a full-circle journey showcasing Hana’s best spots.

4) Backroad – Discover off-the-beaten-path gems on the less-traveled Hana route.

5) Haleakala
Ascend to the summit for breathtaking sunrises and views of the massive volcanic crater, with stops in charming Upcountry towns like Pukalani and Makawao.

6) Iao Valley
Unwind in this lush valley, home to the famous Iao Needle and peaceful hiking trails. It offers a tranquil escape.

7) West Maui
Discover dramatic coastlines, historic Lahaina, and hidden beaches like Honolua Bay and DT Fleming Beach Park.

8) South Maui
Relax on the sun-soaked beaches of Kihei and Wailea, or snorkel in Turtle Town before heading to the remote beauty of La Perouse Bay.

• Why Choose GyPSy Guide?
‣ One Download, Full Access: Get all 8 routes in a single app—cover the entire island without juggling multiple tours.

‣ GPS-Triggered Audio: Explore effortlessly as 465+ stories play automatically, packed with local legends and insider tips.

‣ Offline Navigation: No Wi-Fi or data needed—enjoy offline freedom with seamless GPS guidance.

‣ Expert Insights: Discover Maui’s top highlights and hidden gems with advice on must-see viewpoints, side trips, and cultural stories.

• Must-See Stops:
‣ Seven Sacred Pools at Oheo
‣ Wai’anapanapa State Park and Black Sand Beach
‣ Haleakala Crater and Kalahaku Overlook
‣ Iao Needle
‣ Lahaina Town and Ka’anapali Beach
‣ Makena Beach, Wailea Beach, and Molokini Crater

• Experience Maui Like a Local
From scenic drives to iconic landmarks, GyPSy Guide brings the entire island to life. Whether tackling the Road to Hana, hiking Haleakala, or relaxing on South Maui’s beaches, this tour is your key to unlocking Maui’s most unforgettable moments. It’s like having a personal tour guide in your car!

• Important Notes:
‣ Reservations Required: Some parks like Wai’anapanapa require reservations.
‣ Road Restrictions: Some routes, like the Backroad on the Road to Hana, may have driving restrictions with rental cars—check before you go.

What Our Ohana is Saying:
“We downloaded Gypsy Maui and used it every day in Maui. Great information and great tips...funny too”

“If you are visiting Maui, you absolutely need to download this app. The guide gives so much valuable and interesting information while driving. During the Road to Hana, the guide gives must see stops that we normally would not know about. On the drive back, the guide dives into the history of Hawaii which made the drive itself so much easier. My wife and I ran this app every single time we were on the road. It’s worth the money.”

“We saw in another review, the user named the tour guide. Our family named him Toddson Dukelely (yes there is a story behind that). This app was super relevant and when plugged into the Car Play app in the rental car, he just piped in with his stories and instructions as we drove. This app definitely enhanced our trip and was very informative about the entire island and it’s history. Worth purchasing, no doubt!”

Important Info:
iPad Compatibility: Use an iPad with GPS (WiFi + Cellular) for full functionality.
Battery: GPS drains battery—bring a car charger.

No Expiry: Tours never expire—revisit anytime.
